content.headline: Julian & Samantha
content.sub: We can't wait to celebrate the beginning of our forever with you.

content.title: Our Love Story
content.text: From a chance meeting in a cozy Seattle coffee shop to a rainy proposal on the cliffs of Big Sur, our journey together has been filled with laughter, adventure, and endless love. We are so excited to write this next chapter in front of our dearest family and friends.
